This form is used to define/update a function within the SYSADMIN system.
This step must be done before a function can be associated with a menu.
Functions may be any of the following function types: FRM, COM, MENU, HOST,
SQL, QRY (QRY is used for a display-only form, to prevent user input,
except for queries).
The user defines a name for each function entered. For function types of
FRM, COM, SQL, and QRY, the name entered here must match the name of a form
(for FRM and QRY), COM file or SQL script (the COM or SQL file must exist in
the same directory as the SYSMENU form).
The command to be executed must be entered for HOST types only.
Up to three parameters can be associated with a function. For forms, these
become global variables that are passed to, and used by, the form. For
COM and SQL function types, these parameters define the number of arguments
or parameters to be passed when the function is executed.
The FCN_TBL_PRIV block is used to enter the names of tables, views, and
sequences to which the user must have access in order to execute the
function. For each table, Select, Insert, Update, and Delete privileges
can be identified separately. This information can be used in conjunction
with a SYSADMIN script to grant a user access to all tables, views, etc.
required to execute the functions to which that user as access, as determine
d
by the user's FCN_GRP_PRIV privileges.

Item.Name: FCN_TYPE
Item.Hint: Enter COM, FRM, HOST, MENU, QRY or SQL.

Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 if :fcn.fcn_type not in ('SQL','HOST','FRM','QRY','COM','MENU')
 then
 bell;
 message('Invalid function type.');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
--
 execute_trigger('CHECK_DUPLICATES');
end;

Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
if :fcn.fcn_type = ('HOST' )
then
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY( 'FCN.HOST_CMD', INSERT_ALLOWED, PROPERTY_TRUE );
else
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY( 'FCN.HOST_CMD', INSERT_ALLOWED, PROPERTY_FALSE );
end if;
NEXT_ITEM;

Trigger.Name: PRE-INSERT
Trigger.TriggerText:
execute_trigger('CHECK_DUPLICATES');
--
-- Generate a new fcn_id for the new function
--
begin
 select nvl(max(fcn_id),0) + 1
 into :FCN.FCN_ID
 from fcn
 where appl_id = :ctrl_block_1.appl_id;
exception
 when others then
 handle_error;
end;

Trigger.Name: KEY-CREREC
Trigger.TriggerText:
go_block('FCN_TBL_PRIV'); CLEAR_BLOCK;
 go_block('FCN'); CLEAR_BLOCK;

Trigger.Name: KEY-DELREC
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 :global.temp := 0;
 SELECT count (*)
 into :global.temp
 FROM menu_item
 WHERE fcn_id = :fcn.fcn_id
 OR menu_id = :fcn.fcn_id;
--
 if :global.temp <> '0'
 then
 bell;
 message ('Delete aborted, fcn referenced by menu_item.');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 --
 SELECT count(*) into :global.temp
 FROM fcn_tbl_priv
 WHERE fcn_id = :fcn.fcn_id;
 if :global.temp <> '0'
 then
 bell;
 message ('Delete aborted, fcn referenced by fcn_tbl_priv.');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 delete_record;
end ;

Trigger.Name: KEY-DOWN
Trigger.TriggerText:
if :system.last_record = 'FALSE'
then
 down;
 execute_trigger('coord_ftp');
end if;

Trigger.Name: KEY-UP
Trigger.TriggerText:
if :system.cursor_record > 1
then
 up;
 execute_trigger('coord_ftp');
end if;

Trigger.Name: COORD_FTP
Trigger.TriggerText:
:system.suppress_working := 'TRUE';
:system.message_level := '10';
go_block('fcn_tbl_priv');
execute_query;
if :system.block_status = 'NEW'
then
 message ('No records found for function group privileges');
end if;
:system.suppress_working := 'FALSE';
:system.message_level := '0';
go_block('fcn');

Item.Name: TBL_NAME
Item.Hint: Enter table name required by function. Use [KEY-LISTVAL] to display options.

Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 Select 'x' into :global.x
 from system_tables
 where table_name = :TBL_NAME;
exception
 when no_data_found then
 bell;
 message('Invalid table name, Please reenter');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
end;
--
begin
 Select owner
 into :tbl_owner
 from ALL_TABLES
 where TABLE_NAME = :TBL_NAME;
exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 message
 ('Err: Table ' || :tbl_name || ' does not exist ');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 when others then
 handle_error;
end;

Item.Hint: Enter user_id of the table's owner.

Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 Select 'X'
 into :GLOBAL.x
 from ALL_TABLES
 where OWNER = :TBL_OWNER
 and TABLE_NAME = :TBL_NAME;
exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then

 ('Err: Table with this owner is not accessible to you.');
 raise form_trigger_failure;

end;

Trigger.Name: CHECK_DUPLICATES
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 :global.x := '';
 select 'X' into :global.x
 from FCN
 where FCN_TYPE = :FCN_TYPE
 and EXEC_NAME = :EXEC_NAME
 and FCN_ID != :fcn.fcn_id ;
exception
 when no_data_found then null;
 when others then handle_error;
end;
if :global.x = 'X'
then
 bell;
 message ('Duplicate key in index.');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
end if;
